fusions.name: Pressure Round
fusions.desc: Fires a compressed round of air into the first enemy in its path, dealing 34 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Report Shockwave
fusions.desc: A sudden crack of air bursts from you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Extended Bore
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Primed Chamber
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
